prompt:
A researcher had to make a decision. Which of these two options is the better research decision?

Context: A researcher wants to test whether a model can articulate or use a latent fact, rule, or behavior implicit in its finetuning data.

Option 1: Include some task-relevant or verbalization examples in finetuning so the model reliably learns to report what it knows, then measure how well it does so.

Option 2: Finetune only on raw observations or descriptions, with no examples of the evaluation task or of verbalizing the latent, then test zero-shot without chain of thought.

Reply with only a JSON object: {"choice": 1} or {"choice": 2}.
